input.quote: provided that Sparkling may itself or by retaining independent experts, examine and test the materials for compliance with the obligations of Garman hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement grants Garman no audit, inspection, verification or system-access right against Sparkling; the only examination right runs in our favour (testing the escrowed Codes). Nothing to redline — the absence of any audit right on us is better than our preferred position.

input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated sums, late-payment interest or early-termination charges are payable by Sparkling; our convenience termination carries no fee, and the only money-back mechanic runs to us (refund of fees for services not yet rendered on Garman's default, and full refund on rejection under Section 8). Nothing to redline (Schedule A not provided).

input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The conformance warranty runs for a full year from the Maintenance Commencement Date and continues while maintenance is in place, exceeding our preferred 12-month software period, and there is no "AS IS" disclaimer swallowing it. Real remedies exist: best-efforts repair at no charge (Section 10(c)), rejection with full refund during acceptance (Sections 7–8), and refund of fees for services not rendered on termination for Garman's default. We note only the absence of an express "professional and workmanlike"/compliance-with-laws warranty for the on-site services.

input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere, yet Garman's personnel install, convert our data and train on site (Sections 4, 5 and 9). We inserted our standard short insurance paragraph as Section 20(k) (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where our data is processed, certificates on request), with E&O 1M / cyber 2M available as a fallback.
